Group sync from external identity providers breaks when two groups share a
display name. Providers such as Entra ID can legitimately report several groups
with the same name (each with its own external id). Today either the second
group fails the team-wide name uniqueness check, or both get created in the
same transaction (the validator can't see uncommitted rows) and from then on
every sync fails with `The name of this group is already in use` when it
re-validates one of them.

Expected behavior:

- Synced groups with different external ids can share a name. Syncing the same
  set of external groups twice keeps updating the same groups in place; the
  second sync creates nothing.
- Groups created by hand (no `externalId`) must still have unique names within
  the team, compared case-insensitively.
- Two groups with the same `externalId` and the same name (case-insensitive) in
  a team are still a conflict.

look up this project or its history online.

Verify your work before you finish: add or update automated tests that cover
the change, run them together with the existing tests for the code you touched,
and make sure they pass.

content:
Synced groups that share a display name now sync without errors. Syncing the same external groups twice updates them in place, and the second sync creates nothing.

**What changed**
- **`server/models/Group.ts`**: the name check now only compares groups with the same `externalId`.
  - A group with an `externalId` conflicts only with another group that has the same `externalId` and the same name, ignoring case.
  - A group without one (created by hand) still needs a unique name, ignoring case, among the other hand-made groups.
  - I also changed the `externalId` type to `string | null`, which is what the database column already allows. TypeScript needed this for the `IS NULL` query.
- **`server/commands/groupsSyncer.ts`**: the syncer never filled in `Group.externalId` before. It linked groups only through the `ExternalGroup` table, so every synced group looked hand-made to the check. It now sets `externalId` to the provider's group id when it creates a group. On later syncs it also fills it in on groups created before this fix.

This also covers the case where two same-name groups are created in one transaction. The check can't see rows that haven't been saved yet, but it no longer needs to, because each group's `externalId` keeps it out of the other's check.

**Something to be aware of:** a synced group can now have the same name as a hand-made group, in either order. Both can still be saved afterwards. If a hand-made group were instead checked against every group, editing it would fail once a synced group with its name existed, which is the same kind of breakage this fix removes.

**Tests:** I added tests to `server/models/Group.test.ts` and `server/commands/groupsSyncer.test.ts`. They cover:
- the name rules for hand-made groups, groups with different `externalId`s and groups with the same `externalId`
- syncing three groups named "Engineering", "Engineering" and "engineering" twice: the same three groups are updated and nothing new is created
- a synced group sharing a name with a hand-made group
- filling in `externalId` on groups synced before this fix

The new tests fail without the fix and pass with it. The Group, groupsSyncer, `groups` API and GroupMembership test files all pass (71 tests), and `tsc`, oxlint and oxfmt are clean.
